# Third-party code in web/vendor

- `basic-pitch.mjs` bundles **@spotify/basic-pitch 1.0.1** (Apache-2.0, see
  `LICENSE-basic-pitch.txt`) and **TensorFlow.js 3.21** (Apache-2.0,
  Copyright Google LLC, https://github.com/tensorflow/tfjs). Built with esbuild.
- `basic-pitch-model/` is the Basic Pitch model from the same package (Apache-2.0).

Both are used unmodified, only bundled. The Apache-2.0 text is in
`LICENSE-basic-pitch.txt`.
